title: Biznesmod
description: This mod adds new biomes, a new villager proffesion, new mechanics (upgradable abilities, collecting iron dust to make iron ingots, etc...), new custom structures (10+), a TNT cannon which shoots tnt where you look and some new redstone components.
body: This mod adds new biomes, a new villager proffesion, new mechanics (upgradable abilities, collecting iron dust to make iron ingots, etc...), new custom structures (10+), a TNT cannon which shoots tnt where you look, new redstone components, new weapons: knives. The mod is fun and adds a lot of cool things to early-game proggresion and many custom structures to explore. Hope you like it!
